{{Quote|Ah, that's for me. I always wanted one of these|The pirate on temporarily acquiring a lightsaber|<ref name="A Test of Strength">{{TCW|A Test of Strength}}</ref>}}
A '''Weequay pirate''' served in the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] assisted [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Gwarm/Legends|Gwarm]] in [[Raid on the Crucible/Legends|boarding]] the [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']] to steal the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|Lightsaber crystals]]. This pirate, along with a few others, located [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]], and four of the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]], [[Petro/Legends|Petro]], [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]], and [[Byph/Legends|Byph]]. As a trick, Petro activated his incomplete [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and then tossed it at this pirate. The pirate caught it and activated it, remarking that he always wanted one. Petro, however, had built the lightsaber incorrectly causing it to detonate and knock this pirate unconscious, allowing the younglings and Huyang to escape.<ref name="A Test of Strength" />

This pirate reawakened and followed the younglings and Huyang towards where Hondo and the other pirates were. Huyang sealed this pirate off from the others in order for he and the younglings to escape. While [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] held off the pirates, she ordered [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]] to activate the engines which would break the connecting bridge and cause a vacuum that would suck the pirates out into space. As this happened, this pirate was able to pry open the blast door, only to get sucked out of the Jedi ship. He managed to grab hold of an object in the connecting bridge along with several other pirates, leaving Ahsoka and Hondo to try to keep hold of the wall of the Jedi ship. Ahsoka used the Force and knocked an incoming pirate into Hondo and knock him into the bridge. This pirate managed to keep his grip on the object and grab Hondo at the same time as the bridge slipped away, taking Ahsoka and the pirates with it.<ref name="A Test of Strength" />

[[File:FlorrumPirateRevival3.png|thumb|left|250px|The pirate finds a Z-6 rotary cannon amongst the wreckage]]
After the pirates captured Ahsoka, they had a feast on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. This pirate drank too much [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]], and he was lying around drunk and sleeping. Meanwhile, the younglings came pretending to be parts of [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder]], and rescued Ahsoka. The pirate later took part in the [[Invasion of Florrum/Legends|second battle of Florrum]], when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] attacked Florrum. The pirates cooperated with the Jedi younglings in order to escape.<ref name="Bound for Rescue">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref>

Later in the year, along with [[Jiro/Legends|Jiro]] and some other pirates joined [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] against their former leader [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]. Later on, when the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were overpowered by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and Hondo, the remaining pirates joined Hondo again, and helped him to chase the brothers away from Florrum. One of the pirates managed to shoot the ship with a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]], and the brothers barely escaped in the ship's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. The pirates, believing that the two vaporized, started searching for what remained after them. This pirate found a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]], but Hondo didn't care too much about it.<ref name="Revival" />
